blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Finance and investment veteran Victor Alfonso Limlingan has been appointed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. as the new president and chief executive officer of the Social Security System (SSS). The state insurer made the announcement on Friday. Limlingan succeeded Robert Joseph Montes de Claro, who was appointed secretary of the Department of Information and Communications Technology. READ: Marcos names SSS president de Claro as new DICT chief In a press release, SSS said Limlingan will focus on enhancing and expanding member loan programs, improving the investment portfolio’s risk-adjusted returns, and relaunching the Pension Booster Program.
